runtime_limit: No pinned WordPress and form-plugin runtime is available in this checkout; source and synthetic fixtures are not runtime proof.

cases.expected_behavior: The adapter path must populate or preserve attribution when the form is rendered through its AJAX/cache path.
A validation failure must not be treated as a successful provider record or ClickTrail submission.
A successful submission must invoke the adapter path and produce the expected ClickTrail event.
Granted marketing consent must allow the documented attribution path.
Denied marketing consent must block or redact the documented attribution path without a false success.
The named provider-owned storage surface must be inspected separately from hook payload and ClickTrail event evidence.

certification.rule: runtime_verified requires all six cases to carry runtime evidence metadata from a pinned WordPress/plugin runtime.
